scen.name: Forced escalation — before Nov 3
scen.tells: tanker seizure in the 'restricted zone' · Ras Laffan / Fujairah / pipeline hit · US warship hit · US casualties · Houthi Red Sea attacks · Ghalibaf-style 'no proportional response' rhetoric
scen.text: Our base case. Tehran reads Nov 3 as Trump's weak point and raises the cost before it: tanker seizures, a Gulf energy strike, a US-base hit or the Houthis on the Red Sea. Oil $110–130 into the vote. After Nov 3 the US pot cools; Iran's stays hot.

narr: The IRGC says it fired on two US destroyers, eight tankers and ten more ships for crossing its declared off-limits zone, and that the strait is “firmly under the control” of its navy. The Oman corridor maps are agreed and, it says, days from signature.
CENTCOM calls the claim of a successful strike on a US warship “completely FALSE” — no warship has been struck, every IRGC attempt has failed. With the E3 it carried the IAEA board 23–3.

UKMTO confirms several merchant ships hit by disabling fire on both sides of the strait, one listing off Dubai. 12 in / 12 out on Sep 8 by AIS; PortWatch still 4.3 a day to Aug 30. Brent $101.17, rial 235,400. Live feed: 1,382 ships, 73 aircraft, one military.
